verdict.rationale: Crossplane's own docs describe reconciliation-driven automation. The control plane automatically corrects drift when resources diverge from desired state, and users configure function pipelines that return configuration for Crossplane to apply. An alpha 'realtime compositions' flag also suggests event-driven reconciliation. This is a declarative control loop, though, not a documented facility for writing explicit event-to-action rules. missing for 10: explicit user-defined event-trigger rules, documentation of which events trigger which actions, detail on realtime compositions behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
